# DT Effects 1.0.14

**DT Transient Shaper — cleaner splits**
- Rebuilt as a click-free transient/sustain split: both Attack and Sustain dials are
  always live, and the bottom of either dial fully mutes that half so you can isolate
  transients or sustain. Short lookahead removes the onset click. New "Isolate
  Transients / Sustain" presets.

**Dynamics / automation fixes**
- DT Gate: click-free gain path + new **Range** control (defaults to full mute).
- DT Clipper / DT Distortion output link no longer fights host automation.
- DT Multiband Comp: auto loudness-match backs off gracefully when you automate Output.

**Interface**
- Every pop-up dialog (Save Preset, confirmations, errors) restyled on-brand to match
  the rest of the UI.
